title: Tres emprendedoras con soluciones de IA para salud mental, visual y retail ganan eNOVADORAS
summary: Tres emprendedoras mexicanas —fundadoras de Getin, PROSPEiA y Cuéntame— ganaron el premio eNOVADORAS 2026 de AT&T México por aplicar inteligencia artificial a retail, detección de enfermedades y salud mental organizacional. Fueron seleccionadas entre 45 proyectos tras un programa de aceleración con Endeavor México y el Tecnológico de Monterrey, y accederán a un fondo de hasta 100,000 dólares.

title: Indicadores del 3 al 7 de agosto: Remesas, inflación y anuncio de Banxico
summary: La primera semana de agosto trae una agenda cargada para los mercados mexicanos: el Inegi publicará la Encuesta Mensual de Opinión Empresarial y remesas de junio, mientras Banxico difundirá su encuesta de expectativas de los especialistas del sector privado sobre inflación, crecimiento y tipo de cambio. También se esperan datos de empleo en EU, confianza del consumidor e inversión fija, indicadores clave para calibrar el rumbo de la política monetaria.

title: Hacia la ley mexicana de la inteligencia artificial y sus derivados: buques autónomos, drones y robots
summary: Un análisis de opinión en El Financiero argumenta que la IA ya no es solo software: el Código MASS de la OMI, vigente desde julio, regula por primera vez los buques de carga autónomos, mientras drones y vehículos ya operan comercialmente. El autor sostiene que México necesita avanzar hacia un marco jurídico propio para la IA y sus derivados físicos —robots, drones, embarcaciones autónomas— ante la creciente disputa global por semiconductores y energía.

title: China's Next AI Race Goes Beyond Chatbots
summary: Bloomberg Opinion argues that Washington's focus on China's chatbot model Kimi K3 overlooks Beijing's bigger push to move AI beyond conversational tools and into the physical world. Columnist Catherine Thorbecke frames this as the real frontier of the US-China AI race.

title: DeepSeek lanza el modelo de IA más barato del mundo y supera a la competencia en coste de ejecución
summary: DeepSeek presentó su modelo V4-Flash, que según la firma Artificial Analysis es más de 100 veces más barato de ejecutar que Claude Fable 5 de Anthropic, cobrando 0.14 dólares por millón de tokens de entrada. La startup china, que según algunas fuentes se prepara para una posible salida a bolsa, busca recuperar el impulso que tuvo con su modelo R1 a inicios de 2025, cuando desató una ola de ventas en acciones tecnológicas globales.

title: Palantir Is Stuck in Worst-of-Both-Worlds Bind With AI, Software
summary: Palantir shares have fallen more than 40% from their November peak, leaving the company caught between investors who view it as an AI software winner and skeptics wary of its high valuation. The stock's slide reflects broader market anxiety about whether AI-linked software firms can justify their premiums.

title: The AI Domination Race is Adding to US-China Tensions
summary: A Bloomberg newsletter examines how Washington's use of export controls and other restrictions to slow China's AI progress is intensifying friction between the two countries. The piece frames the AI race as an increasingly central axis of US-China tension, beyond trade and semiconductors alone.

title: Analistas vs Hacienda: ¿cómo le irá a la economía de México rumbo al cierre del 2026?
summary: La economía mexicana creció 1.5% trimestral y 2.2% anual en el segundo trimestre, su mejor avance desde 2020, impulsada por el campo, el Mundial 2026 y exportaciones récord, aunque la inversión privada sigue deprimida. De cara al cierre de 2026, el mercado vigila la revisión del T-MEC y si el Paquete Económico 2027 logrará convencer a las calificadoras sobre el déficit fiscal, en medio de un optimismo oficial mayor al de los analistas privados.

title: AI Chip Designer DeepX’s Value Surges to $2.2 Billion in Funding
summary: South Korean AI chip designer DeepX raised fresh funding at roughly four times its previous valuation, underscoring continued investor enthusiasm for AI infrastructure plays. The round signals sustained capital flows into chip designers positioning themselves for the AI hardware buildout.

title: Apple Siri AI vs. ChatGPT: Which AI Assistant Is Better?
summary: Apple's Siri AI, launching this fall in iOS 27, will instantly become the most widely distributed AI chatbot given the iPhone's global install base, setting up a direct comparison with ChatGPT. The piece weighs how the two assistants stack up as Apple enters the consumer AI race in earnest.

title: ASML Supplier Zeiss Says It Can Handle Demand for Key AI Parts
summary: Zeiss, a key supplier to chipmaking equipment maker ASML, pushed back on investor concerns about bottlenecks in the AI semiconductor supply chain, saying it has the capacity to meet booming demand. The comments offer reassurance on one of the critical chokepoints in AI chip manufacturing.

title: The Cyber Alchemist's Ghosh on AI Cyber-security risks
summary: Ajoy Ghosh, founder of The Cyber Alchemist, discussed cybersecurity measures companies should adopt following recent hacking incidents disclosed by Anthropic and OpenAI. Speaking on Bloomberg's Asia Trade, he outlined AI-specific security risks now facing enterprises.

title: Wall Street learns to love blockchain
summary: The Financial Times reports that major financial firms are increasingly embracing blockchain technology in hopes of modernizing capital markets infrastructure. However, the piece cautions that systemic risks from wider blockchain adoption in finance remain unresolved.

title: Alibaba’s Qwen3.8-Max AI Model Claims Benchmark Scores Rivaling Anthropic
summary: Alibaba released Qwen3.8-Max, its largest AI model yet, claiming benchmark performance on par with Anthropic — the latest in a string of Chinese model releases challenging US AI leaders. The launch underscores the intensifying competition between Chinese and American frontier AI labs.

title: AI Is Turning Retail Traders Into DIY Hedge Funds
summary: Bloomberg explores how the rollout of powerful new AI tools is enabling a generation of retail day traders to build their own automated trading strategies, in effect creating DIY hedge funds. The trend raises questions about how AI-driven retail trading could reshape market dynamics.

title: Who Governs the AI Boom?
summary: Economist Jason Furman argues in a Bloomberg interview that not every AI risk warrants the same governance response — some, like bioweapon risk, call for direct government intervention, while others, like job displacement, may be better left to market adaptation. He frames the central AI policy debate as ultimately a moral question about where lines should be drawn.
